messages:
maria-g: Quick sync on RCX-42 postmortem actions. Pulled cross-team list below — need owners + firm ETAs. Please confirm by EOD tomorrow so we can lock release windows.

Actions (short):
```- A1: app fallback + circuit-breaker -> due 2025-03-22
- A2: infra autoscale tweak + safety test -> due 2025-03-24
- A3: canary deploy + rollback runbook -> due 2025-03-25
- A4: telemetry thresholds + alert tuning -> due 2025-03-23
```
Assigning suggestions; reply if you want a different owner and drop PR/ticket links.

ajay: I can take A1 (app layer) — 2025-03-22 target. Will open PR today and add unit + integration notes. @kevin_t can you confirm timeout defaults for the circuit-breaker?

kevin_t: ack. I can suggest defaults (500ms/1s window) but A2 is infra-heavy. I don't have bandwidth to run the safety perf test before 3/24 unless sasha helps.

sasha: I can run the safety test and execute the autoscale job on staging. A2 -> sasha, 2025-03-24 works. Need the small infra runbook (container flags + envs) from kevin.

ajay: thx @sasha. I'll open PR for A1 now and add integration smoke steps.

kevin_t: infra handoff checklist I will use:
```
- update autoscaler: max_replicas=50, buffer=10%
- pre-scale canary: ensure <30s startup guard
- run `make smoke-staging && ./scale-test --samples 30m`
- tag infra PR with `infra:rcx-42`
```
I'll paste PR link once created.

opsbot: Created ticket INC-2026-42 in Tracker and added labels: postmortem, rcx-42, infra. (ticket -> https://tracker/redwood/INC-2026-42)

ajay: PR opened A1 -> https://git/redwood/app/pull/2412 — reviewers: sasha, maria-g. ETA merge 2025-03-21 if no blockers.

sasha: Infra draft PR -> https://git/redwood/infra/pull/889. I'll run smoke tonight and upload artifacts. Assigned to A2.

maria-g: Current owner/ETA snapshot: A1: ajay — 2025-03-22 (PR #2412); A2: sasha — 2025-03-24 (PR #889, tests pending); A3: kevin_t (deploy plan) + ajay (canary app changes) — 2025-03-25; A4: maria-g (telemetry) — 2025-03-23 (I'll open alert PR). If any date slips, reply here with new ETA. I'll update INC-2026-42 with owners and close loop once PRs merged and canary green. :thumbsup:

kevin_t: small ask — add a canary rollback script to the ops runbook. I'll draft a snippet and attach to A3 PR.

maria-g: yes please — tag me on the PR. Once merged I'll run final acceptance and confirm closure.

sasha: smoke passed on staging; pushing test logs to PR 889 now.

ajay: adding integration smoke to PR 2412 tomorrow morning.

opsbot: INC-2026-42 updated: owners set (ajay, sasha, kevin_t, maria-g), status: in-progress.

maria-g: Great progress — thanks team. I'll post an end-of-day owner/ETA snapshot tomorrow.
